text.card: A red giant 3,794 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.19 solar masses and 14.0 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,649 K at its surface.
